title: TrueQOL modpack
description: A list of essential qol mods for 1.20.1!
body:
True QoL Mods

A lightweight Fabric quality-of-life modpack focused on improving Minecraft’s interface, inventory management, and overall usability while keeping the vanilla experience intact.

This pack includes useful client-side mods such as:

Inventory Profiles Next
Mouse Tweaks
Jade
Just Enough Items (JEI)
AppleSkin
Zoomify
Mod Menu
ShulkerBoxTooltip
No Chat Reports
and more helpful utilities
Features
Better inventory management
Cleaner and more informative UI
Faster item browsing and crafting lookup
Improved tooltips and HUD information
Smooth zoom functionality
Fully client-side compatible
Important
Fabric required
Designed for Minecraft 1.20.1
Client-side only
No gameplay-changing content mods

Simple, clean, and true QoL improvements for everyday Minecraft gameplay.
